heroLede: We're the strategy and technology partner behind growing businesses. We take the pressure off your day, so you can focus on your customers and your next move.
proofLine: Some of the organisations we've built with.
builtTitle: Built around how your business runs.
builtLede: We've shipped booking systems, learning platforms, a creator marketplace and multilingual sites.
sectors: Trusted by clinics, schools, ministries and startups.
workTitleSecond: we built to make a difference.
workTitle: Some of the projects we built to make a difference.
diff1Title: You work with the person doing the work.
diff1Body: One lead takes your project from the first call to launch. You won't be passed to an account manager.
diff2Title: We bring in specialists when you need them.
diff2Body: For a mobile app, a payments integration or a data project, we add people who've done exactly that before. You don't pay for a large team you don't need.
diff3Title: We build for how your customers actually pay and talk.
diff3Body: Mobile money and Paystack in Ghana and Nigeria. Square and insurance claims in the US. WhatsApp and SMS where email gets ignored.
diff4Title: You can see what you're paying for.
diff4Body: Our client portal shows every change we ship, how long it took and what's next.
diff5Body: We host, monitor and update what we build, so you're not left with a site nobody maintains.
labText: We're building SmartCRM, a simple CRM for businesses that keep their customers in WhatsApp chats and notebooks.
servicesLede: The brand and the website, the software your team runs, apps for iPhone and Android, and the reminders and reports that update on their own.
groupBrandBody: We help you establish your look from the first click. We shape your brand and build the website that turns visitors into enquiries.
groupWebBody: We help you build software around how your business works. We set it up so customers can book, pay and sign in, and your team can run the day from one place.
groupMobileBody: We help you put your service in people's pockets. Native feel on iPhone and Android, with the same systems your team already uses.
groupAutoBody: We help you cut the manual follow-up. Reminders, reports and hand-offs that update themselves so your team can focus on the work that needs a person.
